brief:
José Andrés, founder of World Central Kitchen, has renewed calls for an independent investigation into Israeli strikes that killed members of the humanitarian organization's Gaza staff, Al Jazeera English reported. The strikes claimed the lives of WCK workers operating in the territory.

Andrés had previously suspended the charity's operations in Gaza following the deaths. His latest statement represents a continued push for accountability and a formal examination of the circumstances surrounding the incident. An independent probe would assess whether proper precautions were taken and clarify the details of how the strikes occurred.
dek: World Central Kitchen founder José Andrés is renewing his call for an independent investigation into Israeli strikes.
title: Andrés demands independent probe into Israeli strikes killing WCK staff
